02363 chuwsh {koosh}

字根型; TWOT - 631; 動詞

欽定本 - haste 19, ready 1; 20

1) 急忙, 趕快, 匆促
   1a) (Qal) 趕快
   1b) (Hiphil)
       1b1) 動作很快, 顯出匆忙, 趕快到來
       1b2) 加快 (#詩55:8;賽60:22|)
2) 感受, 享受
   2a) (Qal) (#傳2:25|)
record.edic_text:
02363 chuwsh {koosh}

a primitive root; TWOT - 631; v

AV - haste 19, ready 1; 20

1) to haste, make haste, hurry
   1a) (Qal) to make haste
   1b) (Hiphil)
       1b1) to show haste, act quickly, hasten, come quickly
       1b2) to enjoy, be excited
